sealed_statement.carrier_implies_P_equals_NP: E6 polynomially embeds arbitrary 3-SAT exactly into authoritative connected source states. A universal polynomial exact carrier satisfying the E7 contract decides those states in polynomial time, hence decides 3-SAT in polynomial time and implies P=NP.
sealed_statement.P_equals_NP_implies_carrier: Conditionally assume P=NP. Then polynomial SAT decision plus standard self-reduction, the polynomial E6 signed-factor representation, constant-size local C7 witness tables, deterministic B2B1 update bookkeeping, and independent receipts yield a polynomial exact carrier supporting base feasibility, R1, R2, successful updates, and reconstruction.
sealed_statement.equivalence: Under the declared E7 carrier contract, universal polynomial exact carrier existence for the unrestricted connected E6 signed-Huang class is equivalent to P=NP.
sealed_statement.frontier_meaning: The unrestricted carrier problem is no longer a routine missing structural lemma. Solving it positively is itself a P=NP proof; failure to solve it supplies no evidence for P!=NP.

scope_firewall.covered: unrestricted authoritative E6 signed-Huang connected source class
scope_firewall.not_claimed: all P7-free source states are equivalent to E6 or solved by this theorem
